units.text: INT. TRAIN COMPARTMENT - NIGHT
A first-class compartment, 1938.
Plush seats, brass fittings, a lamp with a fringed shade.
The wheels beat out a steady rhythm.
A young woman in a dark traveling suit sits very straight with a small suitcase on her knees.
Across from her, a man in his forties in a gray overcoat sits behind a newspaper, the paper lowering by degrees.
Forgive me. You're traveling alone?
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: I am.
units.name: CLAUDINE

units.text: A long way to go alone.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: I have been going a long way for some time.
units.name: CLAUDINE

units.text: He folds the newspaper and sets it aside.
She keeps her hands on the suitcase.
You'll pardon an old man's curiosity. Your gloves. They're a man's.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: They were my father's.
units.name: CLAUDINE

units.text: And where is your father?
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: That is the question I am traveling to answer.
units.name: CLAUDINE

units.text: He studies her.
The lamp sways.
Then perhaps I can help you.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Why would you?
units.name: CLAUDINE

units.text: Because I knew him.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: She does not move.
The suitcase lid trembles under her fingers.
What was his name?
units.name: CLAUDINE

units.text: Anton Rieux.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: And yours?
units.name: CLAUDINE

units.text: Mine?
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: You know his name. I would like to know yours.
units.name: CLAUDINE

units.text: Reynard.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Mr. Reynard.
units.name: CLAUDINE

units.text: Just Reynard.
units.name: REYNARD

units.text: Then, Reynard, tell me where he is.
units.name: CLAUDINE

units.text: Mademoiselle. He is in the next car.
units.name: REYNARD

units.text: The train rattles through a tunnel.
The lamp flickers out, and for three seconds there is only the sound of wheels.
When it flares back, Claudine has opened the suitcase.
Her hand rests on what is inside it.
